The proposed list fails the mean condition. Its sum is 8·1 + 2·3 + 13·3 + 15·8 + 28 = 201, but mean 8 over 23 elements requires sum 184.

The answer 23 is also not the minimum. A valid list of 89 elements exists: 22 ones, 22 twos, 21 thirteens, 23 fifteens, and one 28. Its sum is 712 = 8·89, the median (45th element) is 13, 15 is the unique mode (23 copies, versus 22 for 1 and 2 and 21 for 13), and the range is 27. A weight argument on the deviations from 8 shows that no odd-length list with the required properties has fewer than 89 elements, and the even-length cases need at least 110.

VERDICT: REJECT
CONFIDENCE: 4
